spoken_script: DeepSeek Launches V4.1-Flash Multimodal Model. DeepSeek has released DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a 552B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model featuring a 1M-token context window and a new Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture designed to reduce KV cache memory requirements. Why it matters: The model's focus on memory efficiency through Compressed Sparse Attention 2 could lower operational costs for large-scale deployments, though early reports suggest potential inconsistencies in specialized reasoning tasks.
